name: Chococo
usp: British artisan chocolatier offering handcrafted single-origin chocolate bars, bonbons, and truffles sourced directly from farmers in Colombia and Ecuador, with cafe seating for specialty coffee and hot chocolate.

name: Confectionery
usp: Vegan artisanal chocolate and pastry shop offering handcrafted dark and white chocolate bonbons with unique flavor combinations (rosemary sea salt caramel, preserved lemon thyme), vegan macarons, and baked goods.

name: Neuhaus Soho
usp: Belgian luxury chocolatier and inventor of the original praline (1912), selling handcrafted bonbons and chocolate bars made in Vlezenbeek, Belgium with premium dark and milk chocolate varieties.

name: Mojo Desserts
usp: America's first chocolate mousse bar, offering artisanal handcrafted mousses made with Belgian Callebaut chocolate (70% dark cacao featured), emphasizing simplicity and freshness with rotating seasonal flavors.
